events.title: Deep Breach Demo for Mac Is Now Available 🍎
events.summary: Hello everyone,The Deep Breach demo is now available for Mac.This is the first public Mac build, so I would really appreciate feedback from Mac players, especially about:• Performance• Stability• Graphics issues• Controls• General gameplay feelIf you try it, please let me know your Mac model, RAM amount, and how the demo runs for you.Thank you for playing and helping improve Deep Breach!

events.title: Deep Breach Alpha Demo Released
events.summary: Hello everyone,The first public Alpha Demo of Deep Breach is now available on Steam.Deep Breach is a sci-fi horde survival game where you'll defend the HELIOS facility against escalating alien swarms using research, orbital support, deployable defenses, and customizable weapon loadouts.This is the first public alpha release, which means there is still plenty of balancing, polishing, and improvement ahead. That's exactly why I'm sharing it now — I'd love to hear your honest feedback while develop
